title: Atletico Madrid exploring move for Wolves midfielder Joao Gomes
content:
Atletico Madrid are exploring a move for Wolverhampton Wanderers midfielder Joao Gomes.

Sources briefed on the situation, speaking on the condition of anonymity to protect relationships, indicated Gomes, 25, is on a midfield shortlist Atletico have drawn up ahead of the summer transfer window, alongside Atalanta’s Ederson.

Gomes has a contract with Wolves that runs until 2030, with the option of a further year, having last signed fresh terms in April 2025.

He moved to Molineux from his boyhood club Flamengo in January 2023 and he has made 126 appearances for the club.

The Brazil international has featured 37 times across all competitions for Wolves this season, with the club’s relegation from the Premier League confirmed on Monday.

The Athletic reported Gomes, and fellow Brazil international Andre, are regarded as certain to depart the club in the summer, potentially for big fees.

Atletico, meanwhile, are set to undergo a summer of transition, with long-serving forward Antoine Griezmann joining Orlando City.

The Spanish side have explored the midfield market before this summer, with promising young Mexican midfielder Obed Vargas, 20, joining from Seattle Sounders in January — although he has been used sparingly, making just six La Liga appearances. Conor Gallagher, meanwhile, departed for Tottenham Hotspur.

Gomes has been capped 10 times for Brazil since his senior debut in 2024 but was not included in Carlo Ancelotti’s March squad.

Compatriot Ederson has made 176 appearances for Atalanta since joining from Salernitana in 2022, including featuring 37 times this term.

Atletico are third in La Liga and face Arsenal in the Champions League semi-finals next Wednesday.
